_note: Results from the FULL validation gauntlet (not --quick). The quick run skips Monte Carlo, the parameter sweep and cross-market replication, and can produce a MORE favourable verdict than the full gauntlet. This file records the stricter verdicts so the consolidated report never presents a quick-run verdict as if it were a full one.

results.note: This spec was SUPPORTED under --quick and was DOWNGRADED to FRAGILE by the full gauntlet (Monte Carlo probability of profit 81%, below the 90% bar). That is the gauntlet doing its job, and it is the reason the report names the stages that ran.
